Create Folders and Subfolders for Report

ffcar_create_report_folder.Rd

Function to create a folder and subfolders for a standard ffcar-compatible report.

Usage

ffcar_create_report_folder(chr_folder_name)

Arguments

chr_folder_name

A character string, the folder name. For compatibility with ffcar functions, folder names must start with a letter and can only contain letters, numbers, underscores, or periods.

Value

Creates a folder with relevant subfolders.
